```yaml
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version'
        required: true
        default: '1.4.0'

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python 3.9
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install bump2version pylint setuptools wheel

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pylint custom_components/dreo/
          pytest

      - name: Bump version
        run: |
          bump2version --new-version ${{ github.event.inputs.version }} --allow-dirty --commit --tag custom_components/dreo/manifest.json

      - name: Create release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ github.event.inputs.version }}
          body: |
            This is a release of version v${{ github.event.inputs.version }}

      - name: Package artifacts
        uses: thedoctor0/zip-release@0.7.6
        with:
          filename: dreo-${{ github.event.inputs.version }}.zip
          path: custom_components/dreo/

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: dreo-${{ github.event.inputs.version }}.zip
          asset_name: dreo-${{ github.event.inputs.version }}.zip
          asset_content_type: application/zip
```
